Variants.Content: Dumatha wells and crops sustain herders, travelers and guards. Camels and horses carry goods while consuming water and grass; escort and exchange depend on open routes.

Dumatha wells and crops feed herders, travelers and guards. Traveling followers need real food from this production; valuables still require a buyer and exchange. Escort income depends on continued access to wells.
